basics.name: Alvaro Capaceta Magallanes
basics.label: Full-stack developer with a backend focus. I build web products that work.

summary.paragraph: I'm Alvaro, a full-stack developer building under the name INGCapaDev. I've worked in startup environments, shipping features and collaborating with clients on real products. I care about solving the right problem, keeping the code clean, and making the product feel simple.

I build tools to remove friction from my own work, so I'm often my first user. I write about what I learn on my blog, which you can find in the projects section. That mix of building and writing is how I keep improving.
Long term, I want INGCapaDev to be known for useful software and clear thinking. That matters more to me than shipping more features.

work.name: Voltz
work.summary: I work on a quoting and e-commerce tool for electrical materials. I helped design and build several storefront views, wrote TypeScript scripts to manage a large Firebase database, and built APIs for data collection and analytics. I also added AI features to a chatbot and redesigned the checkout flow, which helped increase conversion.

work.name: Luthor Solutions
work.summary: I built APIs with NestJS and connected them to Neo4j, SQL, Firebase, and SQLite. I also built microservices for email, authentication, reporting, and storage with Firebase and Cloudflare R2, set up Google Analytics across several sites, and turned Figma designs into responsive landing pages with React, Next.js, and Tailwind. I worked on larger React apps with Vite and Redux Toolkit for state and side effects.

projects.name: INGCapaDev AI Workflow
projects.description: A lightweight, human-in-the-loop workflow for AI-assisted development in OpenCode. It focuses on collaborative planning, small tasks, clear evidence, and review from two angles, with an Astro landing page.

projects.name: Aura Series API
projects.description: Private API for Aura Series, a social platform for sharing and discovering series. It covers search, recommendations, authentication, and email for a large user base.

projects.name: Personal Blog
projects.description: My personal blog about web development, productivity, and whatever I'm learning. It's available in English and Spanish, built with Astro, and scores 100/100 on Lighthouse.

projects.name: JB Baseball Game
projects.description: A baseball game simulator for scoring plays and keeping a record of what each player does. It's designed for fullscreen play, with sound effects and state management for a full game.
